text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"The veil of night, howling winds, 
fluttering snow...! And standing 
gallantly, me and—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —This door just won't open at all!!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! It seems the sheer chill has 
frozen the door shut!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Oh no...!? W-W-What should we do, 
Opera O-saaan!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Well, there is no need to rush so. You 
need only continue with your opera 
lessons.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, my passion should melt the 
door right off its hinges. —Now, let the 
opera resume!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“Now, let me strike you down! If you will 
not teach me what fear is, then—!”

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Do your best, Opera O-saaan...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Victory is mine! Now, you are mine! My 
flames shall melt your frozen heart, 
—Turandot!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: You're wonderful, Opera O-saaaan...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A yearning love burns with pure bliss! 
Such joy that brings forth roaring 
cheers...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Isolde...! You belong to me...!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, Doto, you're up next!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeh, me!? U-U-Understood...!*

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "L-Lord Tristan...! You belong to meee—!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "'Aaah—!! The supreme joy of love~~...!'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-clatter...)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Are you two alright?! I didn't know where 
you were, so I'm late—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like my worries were 
unfounded. As long as you had fun, that's 
all that matters♪
